title: Upper-tail indicator identity
statement: For every natural number $n$, real threshold $t$, and point $x$ of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $S$ be the normalized Rademacher sum at $x$ and let $I$ be $1$ if $S>t$ and $0$ otherwise. Then $IS=(	ext{the maximum of }S-t	ext{ and }0)+tI$.
